links.outcome: Accuracy of LLM vs simple Regex baseline for BI-RADS extraction on same reports
links.effect: Accuracy 89.20% Regex vs 87.69% LLM (P = .56, not significant); Regex 28,120 times faster (0.06 s vs 1687.20 s).
links.quote: For structured, standardized data like BI-RADS, traditional NLP techniques seem to be superior, though future work should explore hybrid approaches combining Regex precision for standardized elements with LLM contextual understanding for more complex information extraction tasks.

links.outcome: Whether LLM outperforms simpler non-AI method for structured extraction task
links.effect: LLM was no more accurate than Regex (87.69% vs 89.20%, P = .56) and far slower (1687.20 s vs 0.06 s).
links.quote: Compared to the LLM-based method, Regex processing was more efficient, completing the task 28 120 times faster (0.06 seconds vs 1687.20 seconds).

unlisted_practices: Hybrid approach combining Regex for standardized elements with LLM for complex extraction

screen.reason: The study compares the accuracy and processing speed of an LLM against a rule-based regular expression approach for extracting BI-RADS scores from radiology reports on a retrospective benchmark dataset without testing a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
